    requestHash: string;

    constructor(message?: string);
}

// ClaimOutcome
type ClaimOutcome = {
    type: "claimed";
    token: string;
} | {
    type: "replay";
    result: StoredResult;
} | {
    type: "conflict";
} | {
    type: "in_progress";
} | {
    type: "gone";
};

// CompleteInput
interface CompleteInput extends RecordId {
    token: string;
    result: StoredResult;
    resourceRef?: string;
}

// CreateResult
interface CreateResult extends StoredResult {
    resourceRef?: string;
}

// DraftAccepted

}

// DraftLog

    append(tx: Tx, owner: string, update: NewDraftUpdate & {
        id: string;

}

// HeaderSource
type HeaderSource = {
    get(name: string): string | null | undefined;
} | Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>;

// IdempotencyStore
interface IdempotencyStore<Tx = unknown> {
    claim(input: ClaimInput): Promise<ClaimOutcome>;
    transaction<T>(fn: (tx: Tx) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>;
    completeInTransaction(tx: Tx, input: CompleteInput): Promise<void>;
    release(id: RecordId, token: string): Promise<void>;
    tombstoneResource(tx: Tx, resource: ResourceId): Promise<number>;
    purgeExpired(now?: number): Promise<number>;
    forgetOwner(owner: string): Promise<number>;
}

// IdempotentAnswer
interface IdempotentAnswer {
    status: number;
    body: unknown;
    headers: Record<string, string>;
    outcome: "created" | "replayed" | "not_stored" | "unkeyed" | "conflict" | "in_progress" | "gone" | "invalid_key" | "key_required" | "invalid_content";
}

type KeyRead = {

    ok: false;
};
